spans.s:
m. (-गः)
1 Pleasure, enjoyment.
2

Wealth.
3

Nourishing, cherishing.
4

Eating.
5

A snake's body.
6 A snake's expanded hood.
7

Hire.
8

The hire of dancing girls or courtezans.
9 A snake.
10 An army in column.
11 (In arithmetic,) The numerator of a fraction.
E.
भुज to eat, &c., aff. घञ्.

n. (-च्छं)
Price paid to harlots.

m. (-हः)
The inner or private apartment, the haram.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and गृह a house.

m. (-तिः)
1 A viceroy, a governor.
2 A person having possession or usufruct.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and पति master.

m. (-लः)
A groom.
E.
भोग pleasure, and पाल who nourishes.

f. (-का)
Hunger.
E.
भोग eating, पिशाचिका an imp.

f. (-मिः)
Svarga or paradise.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and भूमि soil.

m. (-कः)
A servant or slave, who works for maintenance only.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and भृत्तक a hireling.

m. (-भः)
Interest or profit made by the use of any thing pledged.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and लाभ gain.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Enjoying, having enjoyment.
2 Delightful, pleasurable, yielding enjoyment.
m. (-वान्)
1 A snake.
2 Dancing, acting.
3 Singing.
f. (-ती)
1 The capital of the Nāgas, or serpents.
2 The Ganges of the lower regions.
E.
भोग enjoyment, aff. मतुप्.

n. (-द्म)
The inner apartment, the haram.
E.
भोग pleasure, and सद्मन् a dwelling.

n. (-नं)
1 The body as the seat, of sensual enjoyment.
2 A haram, &c.
E.
भोग enjoyment, and स्थान place.

n. (-र्हं)
Wealth, property.
E.
भोग, and अर्ह fit for.

f. (-ली)
Praise, eulogium, the panegyric of professional encomiasts or bards.
E.
भोग enjoyment, आवली a row or range.

m. (-सः)
The haram, the inner or women's apartment.
E.
भोग enjoyment, आवास abode.

m. (-कः)
A horse-keeper, a groom.
E.
भोग pleasure, ठक् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
Air, wind.
E.
भोगि a snake, and कान्त friend.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Enjoying, possessing, an enjoyer, &c.
m. (-गी)
1 A snake.
2 A king, a prince.
3 A barber.
4 The head man of a village.
5 A person who accumulates money for a particular expenditure.
f. (-नी)
1 The capital of the

Nāgas.
2

A royal concubine.
E.
भोग enjoyment, aff. इनि.

n. (-भं)
Sandal.
E.
भोगिन् a snake, वल्लभ beloved.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The serpent ANANTA.
E.
भोगि a snake, इन्द्र a sovereign; also भोगीश.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
To be enjoyed.
n. (-ग्यं)
1

Wealth.
2

Grain.
f. (-ग्या)
A whore.
E.
भुज to enjoy, aff. ण्यत्.
